new.question_text: In viaggio: zaino leggero o valigia per ogni evenienza?
new.question_text_en: Travelling: a light backpack or a suitcase for every scenario?

new.question_text: Una vacanza: tutto il tempo in un posto o tante tappe?
new.question_text_en: A holiday: one place the whole time or lots of stops?

new.question_text: Si parte: all’alba o con calma dopo pranzo?
new.question_text_en: Setting off: at dawn or calmly after lunch?

new.question_text: Un viaggio insieme: in treno o in macchina?
new.question_text_en: A trip together: by train or by car?

new.question_text: Una mattina libera: colazione a letto o al bar?
new.question_text_en: A free morning: breakfast in bed or at a café?

new.question_text: Per dormire: buio totale o un filo di luce?
new.question_text_en: For sleeping: total darkness or a sliver of light?

new.question_text: Il letto la mattina: rifatto subito o lasciato così?
new.question_text_en: The bed in the morning: made right away or left as it is?

new.question_text: Una casa piena di piante o piena di libri?
new.question_text_en: A home full of plants or full of books?

new.question_text: La sera, sul divano: tisana o un bicchiere di vino?
new.question_text_en: Evening on the couch: herbal tea or a glass of wine?

new.question_text: La merenda dell’infanzia: pane e cioccolato o pane e olio?
new.question_text_en: The snack of your childhood: bread and chocolate or bread and olive oil?

new.question_text: Il sabato mattina dell’infanzia: cartoni in TV o giochi in cortile?
new.question_text_en: Childhood Saturday mornings: cartoons on TV or games outside?

new.question_text: Alle giostre: autoscontro o ruota panoramica?
new.question_text_en: At the funfair: bumper cars or the Ferris wheel?

new.question_text: Se dovessi scegliere una portata sola: primo o secondo?
new.question_text_en: If you could only have one course: pasta or the main?

new.question_text: Il gelato: cono o coppetta?
new.question_text_en: Ice cream: cone or cup?

new.question_text: Il caffè: al bar o fatto in casa?
new.question_text_en: Coffee: at a café or made at home?

new.question_text: A tavola: piccante o delicato?
new.question_text_en: At the table: spicy or mild?

new.question_text: Al cinema: prima fila o ultima fila?
new.question_text_en: At the cinema: front row or back row?

new.question_text: Un film già visto cento volte o uno mai visto?
new.question_text_en: A film seen a hundred times or one never seen?

new.question_text: Le canzoni: tutte le parole a memoria o solo il ritornello?
new.question_text_en: Songs: every word by heart or just the chorus?

new.question_text: Una serie nuova: un episodio a sera o tutta in un weekend?
new.question_text_en: A new series: one episode a night or all in one weekend?

new.question_text: Tra dieci anni: città o campagna?
new.question_text_en: Ten years from now: city or countryside?

new.question_text: I risparmi: per un viaggio o per la casa?
new.question_text_en: Savings: for a trip or for a home?

new.question_text: Un progetto insieme: deciso a tavolino o nato per caso?
new.question_text_en: A project together: carefully planned or born by chance?

new.question_text: Il prossimo anniversario: sorpresa o deciso insieme?
new.question_text_en: The next anniversary: a surprise or planned together?

new.question_text: A una festa: tanta gente nuova o i soliti amici?
new.question_text_en: At a party: lots of new people or the usual friends?

new.question_text: Il compleanno: festa grande o cena con pochi intimi?
new.question_text_en: Birthdays: a big party or dinner with a close few?

new.question_text: Una bella notizia: la dico prima agli amici o in famiglia?
new.question_text_en: Good news: do I tell my friends or my family first?

new.question_text: Il bacio del buongiorno: subito o dopo il caffè?
new.question_text_en: The good-morning kiss: right away or after coffee?

new.question_text: A distanza: videochiamata o vocale lungo?
new.question_text_en: Apart: a video call or a long voice note?

new.question_text: Grattini: sulla testa o sulla schiena?
new.question_text_en: Scratches: on the head or on the back?

new.question_text: Un «ti amo»: detto a voce o scritto a sorpresa?
new.question_text_en: An “I love you”: said out loud or written as a surprise?

new.question_text: Un abbraccio: lungo e lento o forte e veloce?
new.question_text_en: A hug: long and slow or tight and quick?
